newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates seesaw on weekly operation.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates seesaw on weekly operation.

text.p: Pakistan's money rates fluctuated widely on Wednesday before ending lower on an open market operation by the central bank, dealers said.

"The market behaved erratically owing to the weekly open market operation today," one dealer said. "Some initial deals were made at 15 percent, but after the announcement of the operation results, the rates crashed to four and seven percent."

Dealers said the State Bank of Pakistan mopped up around six billion rupees at a cut-off of 15 percent, showing a one percent reduction from the last operation rate that would exert pressure on future auction bids and term rates. - Amir Zia 9221-5685192
